swe.pr_description: So far, DiskArrays that returned "Unchunked" as their chunk status seem to not have had tests yet, which lead to #51 . This fixes #51 and adds at least one test that would have covered this use case. It might make sense to add some more tests here, maybe @rafaqz has a few ideas from DimensionalData?
swe.interface:
Method: UnchunkedDiskArray.haschunks(self)  
Location: DiskArrays.haschunks(::UnchunkedDiskArray) → DiskArrays.Unchunked()  
Inputs: `self` – an instance of `UnchunkedDiskArray{T,N,P}` (no additional arguments).  
Outputs: Returns the singleton `DiskArrays.Unchunked()` indicating that the array has no chunking.  
Description: Declares that the custom disk array type is unchunked so that the DiskArrays infrastructure treats it as having a single logical chunk.

Method: UnchunkedDiskArray.size(self)  
Location: Base.size(a::UnchunkedDiskArray) → size(a.p)  
Inputs: `self` – an `UnchunkedDiskArray{T,N,P}` instance.  
Outputs: A tuple of integers representing the dimensions of the underlying parent array `a.p`.  
Description: Provides the standard `size` interface for the disk array by delegating to the stored in‑memory array.

Function: DiskArrays.readblock!(a::UnchunkedDiskArray, aout, i::AbstractUnitRange...)  
Location: DiskArrays.readblock! implementation for `UnchunkedDiskArray`.  
Inputs:  
- `a` – the `UnchunkedDiskArray{T,N,P}` source array.  
- `aout` – an pre‑allocated output array (or view) that will receive the data.  
- `i` – a variadic list of `AbstractUnitRange` objects, one per dimension, specifying the block to read.  
Constraints: The number of index ranges must equal `ndims(a)`; each index must be an `AbstractUnitRange`.  
Outputs: Writes the selected slice `a.p[i...]` into `aout`; returns `nothing`.  
Description: Reads a contiguous block from the underlying parent array into the provided output buffer, enabling `view` and other DiskArrays operations to work with unchunked storage.

llm_metadata.reasoning: The issue reports a breakage when comparing a view of an Unchunked SubDiskArray to a plain array, providing a reproducible example and stacktrace. The added test mirrors this scenario by creating an UnchunkedDiskArray, taking a view, and asserting equality, directly aligning with the reported behavior. No test‑suite coupling, naming expectations, external dependencies beyond a URL, ambiguous specs, unrelated patch artifacts, or hidden domain knowledge are evident. Therefore the task is clearly specified and solvable.
